# Aayush Bhandari (AayusX)

> Computer Engineering student and technology entrepreneur in Nepal. Builds useful web platforms, desktop tools, and small AI systems for schools and small businesses. Co-founder of Yugya.

## Identity

- Real name: Aayush Bhandari
- Online handle: AayusX
- Location: Nepal · working remotely
- Languages: English, Nepali
- Education: Computer Engineering student
- Role: Co-founder of Yugya (hosting, domains, VPS infrastructure, web and app development)

## Selected projects

- Mother School — school platform for Aama Pathshala, Badganga, Kapilvastu (admissions, attendance, grades, report cards, parent portal)
- Loan Management System — Python desktop tool for a college teachers' saving group, in production since 2023
- FailFirst Engine — debug-first learning tool for C, C++ and Java with a bundled compiler
- Gesture Solar — browser experiment using webcam gestures to drive a 3D solar system
- AayushAI Core — local-first assistant experiment (memory, journaling, tool calling)
